CHAPTER I

GENERAL PROVISIONS

Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:

1. Region is Sorong Regency.
2. Regional Government is the Regent and Regional Apparatus Units as elements of Regional Government Administration.
3. Regent is the Regent of Sorong.
4. Regional House of Representatives hereinafter abbreviated as DPRD is the Regional People's Representative Institution which is positioned as an element of Regional Government administration.
5. Discrimination is any distinction, harassment and exclusion, whether direct or indirect, based on human differentiation on the basis of religion, tribe, race, ethnicity, social status group, economic status, gender, language, political beliefs which result in the reduction, deviation or elimination of recognition, implementation or use of human rights and fundamental freedoms in life both individually and collectively in the political, economic, legal, social, cultural and other aspects of life.
6. Violence is any act that results in or causes misery and suffering whether physical, sexual, psychological including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of liberty, whether occurring in public or in private life.
7. Violence against women is any act based on gender differences that results in or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually or arbitrary deprivation of liberty, whether in the domestic or public sphere in private life.
8. Violence against children is any act against a child that results in misery or suffering physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the child.
9. Domestic violence is any act against a person, especially women, that results in misery or suffering physically, sexually, psychologically and or household neglect including threats to commit acts of coercion or unlawful deprivation of liberty within the household sphere.
10. Trafficking in Persons is the act of recruitment, transportation, harboring, sending, transfer, or receipt of a person by means of threat of violence, kidnapping, confinement, forgery, fraud and abuse of power or position of vulnerability, debt bondage or giving payments or benefits, so as to obtain consent from the person holding control over that other person, whether conducted within the country or between countries, for the purpose of exploitation or resulting in the person being exploited.
11. Child is a person who has not reached 18 years of age including a child in the womb.
12. Woman is an adult human being of female gender and a person recognized by law as a woman.
13. Prevention is activities carried out to prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children.
14. Protection is all service actions to guarantee and protect the rights of victims of violence organized by the Integrated Service Center.
15. Physical violence is any act that causes pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage or fainting and or causes death.
16. Psychological violence is an act that causes fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, distrust or severe psychological suffering to a person.
17. Sexual violence is any act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual intercourse, whether unnatural or unwilling with another person for commercial purposes and or certain purposes.
18. Victim is a woman and child who experiences acts of violence. 19. Service is immediate activities and actions carried out by professionals in accordance with their respective professions in the form of counseling, therapy and advocacy for the empowerment and recovery of victims of violence.
20. Assistance is activities and actions carried out by assistants during the service process.
21. Assistant is a person or representative from an institution who has the expertise to provide assistance.
22. Institution is an agency/institution/body/within the scope of regional government and/or non-governmental organization (NGO) that provides assistance. 23. Integrated Service Center hereinafter abbreviated as PPT, is an institution providing services to victims of violence based in hospitals, managed jointly in the form of medical services (including medico-legal), psychosocial and legal services.
24. Safe House is temporary housing, provided to give protection to victims in accordance with predetermined standards.
25. Community is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and/or community organizations.

Article 8

1. The obligations and responsibilities of the community as referred to in Article 6 letter b, are implemented in the form of community participation. (2) The form of community participation as referred to in paragraph (1), includes: a. preventing the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children; b. providing protection to women and children from acts of violence, in the form of making rules and regulations in their respective areas starting from the Neighborhood Association level;
c. providing information and / or reporting acts of violence against women and children to law enforcement or the competent authorities; d. Participating in handling victims of acts of violence; and e. Accompanying victims to service units.
3. The form of community participation as referred to in paragraph (2), is carried out responsibly in accordance with laws and regulations.

CHAPTER V

PREVENTION OF ACTS OF VIOLENCE

Article 10

1. To prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children, the Regional Government conducts socialization, empowerment, and awareness to families, parents, and the community by providing information, guidance and / or counseling.
2. In addition to empowerment and awareness as referred to in paragraph (1), the Regional Government makes efforts as follows: a. increasing the quantity and quality of education both formal and non-formal as well as informal;
b. opening employment opportunities for women;
c. building community participation and concern for the prevention and protection of women and children from acts of violence; and d. building networks and cooperation with law enforcement apparatus, government apparatus, universities and various non-governmental organizations that work and / or care about women and children.

Article 9

The obligations of the family and / or parents as referred to in Article 6 letter c and letter d, who legally have full responsibility to prevent all forms of violence and protect women and children as family members.

CHAPTER VII

INSTITUTIONS

Article 13

1. In the context of providing protection services to women and children from victims of violence, the Regional Government establishes P2TP2A as an integrated service center for the protection of women and children from acts of violence including victims of acts of violence.
2. P2TP2A as referred to in paragraph (1), functions as an integrated service center in providing protection to women and children from acts of violence.
3. P2TP2A as referred to in paragraph (1), above consists of the Health Office, Hospital, Police, Social Service, Manpower Office, Office of Women's Empowerment and Family Planning, Non-Governmental Organizations.
4. P2TP2A as referred to Community Organizations, Socio-Community Organizations, Universities in paragraph (3) is established by Regent's decree. (5) P2TP2A of Sorong Regency in carrying out its duties and functions may coordinate with the network of service units and competent parties in making efforts to protect women and children from acts of violence.

CHAPTER VIII

REPORTING

Article 16

1. P2TP2A of Sorong Regency is obliged to report the implementation of the prevention and protection of women and children from acts of violence to the Regent.
2. Reporting as referred to in paragraph (1) includes: a. administration;
b. finance;
c. services; and d. performance.
3. Submission of written reports as referred to in paragraph (2) is carried out at least once every three (3) months.

Article 15

1. In the context of preventing acts of violence against children including the protection of children from the worst forms of child labor, a committee for the elimination of acts of violence against children will be established by Regent's decree.
2. Further provisions regarding the duties and functions of the committee for the elimination of acts of violence against children as referred to in paragraph (1), are regulated by Regent's regulation.

Article 14

1. For the implementation of services for victims of trafficking in persons, the Regent of Sorong establishes a task force for the criminal act of trafficking in persons.
2. The task force for the criminal act of trafficking in persons as referred to in paragraph (1), is a coordinating institution tasked with coordinating the prevention and handling of trafficking in persons.
3. Further provisions regarding the establishment, duties, and functions of the task force for the criminal act of trafficking in persons as referred to in paragraph (1), are established by Regent's regulation.

8. Violence against children is any act against a child that results in misery or suffering physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the child.
9. Domestic violence is any act against a person, especially women, that results in misery or suffering physically, sexually, psychologically and or household neglect including threats to commit acts of coercion or unlawful deprivation of liberty within the household sphere.
10. Trafficking in Persons is the act of recruitment, transportation, harboring, sending, transfer, or receipt of a person by means of threat of violence, kidnapping, confinement, forgery, fraud and abuse of power or position of vulnerability, debt bondage or giving payments or benefits, so as to obtain consent from the person holding control over that other person, whether conducted within the country or between countries, for the purpose of exploitation or resulting in the person being exploited.
11. Child is a person who has not reached 18 years of age including a child in the womb.
12. Woman is an adult human being of female gender and a person recognized by law as a woman.
13. Prevention is activities carried out to prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children.
14. Protection is all service actions to guarantee and protect the rights of victims of violence organized by the Integrated Service Center.
15. Physical violence is any act that causes pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage or fainting and or causes death.
16. Psychological violence is an act that causes fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, distrust or severe psychological suffering to a person.
17. Sexual violence is any act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual intercourse, whether unnatural or unwilling with another person for commercial purposes and or certain purposes.
18. Victim is a woman and child who experiences acts of violence. 19. Service is immediate activities and actions carried out by professionals in accordance with their respective professions in the form of counseling, therapy and advocacy for the empowerment and recovery of victims of violence.
20. Assistance is activities and actions carried out by assistants during the service process.
21. Assistant is a person or representative from an institution who has the expertise to provide assistance.
22. Institution is an agency/institution/body/within the scope of regional government and/or non-governmental organization (NGO) that provides assistance. 23. Integrated Service Center hereinafter abbreviated as PPT, is an institution providing services to victims of violence based in hospitals, managed jointly in the form of medical services (including medico-legal), psychosocial and legal services.
24. Safe House is temporary housing, provided to give protection to victims in accordance with predetermined standards.
25. Community is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and/or community organizations.

CHAPTER V

PREVENTION OF ACTS OF VIOLENCE

Article 10

1. To prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children, the Regional Government conducts socialization, empowerment, and awareness to families, parents, and the community by providing information, guidance and / or counseling.
2. In addition to empowerment and awareness as referred to in paragraph (1), the Regional Government makes efforts as follows: a. increasing the quantity and quality of education both formal and non-formal as well as informal;
b. opening employment opportunities for women;
c. building community participation and concern for the prevention and protection of women and children from acts of violence; and d. building networks and cooperation with law enforcement apparatus, government apparatus, universities and various non-governmental organizations that work and / or care about women and children.

Article 9

The obligations of the family and / or parents as referred to in Article 6 letter c and letter d, who legally have full responsibility to prevent all forms of violence and protect women and children as family members.

Article 8

1. The obligations and responsibilities of the community as referred to in Article 6 letter b, are implemented in the form of community participation. (2) The form of community participation as referred to in paragraph (1), includes: a. preventing the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children; b. providing protection to women and children from acts of violence, in the form of making rules and regulations in their respective areas starting from the Neighborhood Association level;
c. providing information and / or reporting acts of violence against women and children to law enforcement or the competent authorities; d. Participating in handling victims of acts of violence; and e. Accompanying victims to service units.
3. The form of community participation as referred to in paragraph (2), is carried out responsibly in accordance with laws and regulations.

CHAPTER VII

INSTITUTIONS

Article 13

1. In the context of providing protection services to women and children from victims of violence, the Regional Government establishes P2TP2A as an integrated service center for the protection of women and children from acts of violence including victims of acts of violence.
2. P2TP2A as referred to in paragraph (1), functions as an integrated service center in providing protection to women and children from acts of violence.
3. P2TP2A as referred to in paragraph (1), above consists of the Health Office, Hospital, Police, Social Service, Manpower Office, Office of Women's Empowerment and Family Planning, Non-Governmental Organizations.
4. P2TP2A as referred to Community Organizations, Socio-Community Organizations, Universities in paragraph (3) is established by Regent's decree. (5) P2TP2A of Sorong Regency in carrying out its duties and functions may coordinate with the network of service units and competent parties in making efforts to protect women and children from acts of violence.

INSTITUTIONS

The obligations of the family and / or parents as referred to in Article 6 letter c and letter d, who legally have full responsibility to prevent all forms of violence and protect women and children as family members.

6. Violence is any act that results in or causes misery and suffering whether physical, sexual, psychological including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of liberty, whether occurring in public or in private life.
7. Violence against women is any act based on gender differences that results in or may result in misery or suffering of women physically, sexually or arbitrary deprivation of liberty, whether in the domestic or public sphere in private life.
8. Violence against children is any act against a child that results in misery or suffering physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens bodily integrity and degrades the dignity of the child.
9. Domestic violence is any act against a person, especially women, that results in misery or suffering physically, sexually, psychologically and or household neglect including threats to commit acts of coercion or unlawful deprivation of liberty within the household sphere.
10. Trafficking in Persons is the act of recruitment, transportation, harboring, sending, transfer, or receipt of a person by means of threat of violence, kidnapping, confinement, forgery, fraud and abuse of power or position of vulnerability, debt bondage or giving payments or benefits, so as to obtain consent from the person holding control over that other person, whether conducted within the country or between countries, for the purpose of exploitation or resulting in the person being exploited.
11. Child is a person who has not reached 18 years of age including a child in the womb.
12. Woman is an adult human being of female gender and a person recognized by law as a woman.
13. Prevention is activities carried out to prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children.
14. Protection is all service actions to guarantee and protect the rights of victims of violence organized by the Integrated Service Center.
15. Physical violence is any act that causes pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage or fainting and or causes death.
16. Psychological violence is an act that causes fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, distrust or severe psychological suffering to a person.
17. Sexual violence is any act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual intercourse, whether unnatural or unwilling with another person for commercial purposes and or certain purposes.
18. Victim is a woman and child who experiences acts of violence. 19. Service is immediate activities and actions carried out by professionals in accordance with their respective professions in the form of counseling, therapy and advocacy for the empowerment and recovery of victims of violence.
20. Assistance is activities and actions carried out by assistants during the service process.
21. Assistant is a person or representative from an institution who has the expertise to provide assistance.
22. Institution is an agency/institution/body/within the scope of regional government and/or non-governmental organization (NGO) that provides assistance. 23. 24. Safe House is temporary housing, provided to give protection to victims in accordance with predetermined standards.
25. Community is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and/or community organizations.

REPORTING

Article 16

b. finance;
c. services; and d. performance.

CHAPTER VII

INSTITUTIONS

Article 13

1. In the context of providing protection services to women and children from victims of violence, the Regional Government establishes P2TP2A as an integrated service center for the protection of women and children from acts of violence including victims of acts of violence.
2. P2TP2A as referred to in paragraph (1), functions as an integrated service center in providing protection to women and children from acts of violence.

4. P2TP2A as referred to Community Organizations, Socio-Community Organizations, Universities in paragraph (3) is established by Regent's decree. (5) P2TP2A of Sorong Regency in carrying out its duties and functions may coordinate with the network of service units and competent parties in making efforts to protect women and children from acts of violence.

Article 9

The obligations of the family and / or parents as referred to in Article 6 letter c and letter d, who legally have full responsibility to prevent all forms of violence and protect women and children as family members.

CHAPTER V

PREVENTION OF ACTS OF VIOLENCE

Article 10

1. To prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children, the Regional Government conducts socialization, empowerment, and awareness to families, parents, and the community by providing information, guidance and / or counseling.
2. In addition to empowerment and awareness as referred to in paragraph (1), the Regional Government makes efforts as follows: a. increasing the quantity and quality of education both formal and non-formal as well as informal;
b. opening employment opportunities for women;
c. building community participation and concern for the prevention and protection of women and children from acts of violence; and d. building networks and cooperation with law enforcement apparatus, government apparatus, universities and various non-governmental organizations that work and / or care about women and children.

11. Child is a person who has not reached 18 years of age including a child in the womb.
12. Woman is an adult human being of female gender and a person recognized by law as a woman.
13. Prevention is activities carried out to prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children.
14. Protection is all service actions to guarantee and protect the rights of victims of violence organized by the Integrated Service Center.
15. Physical violence is any act that causes pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage or fainting and or causes death.
16. Psychological violence is an act that causes fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, distrust or severe psychological suffering to a person.
17. Sexual violence is any act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual intercourse, whether unnatural or unwilling with another person for commercial purposes and or certain purposes.
18. Victim is a woman and child who experiences acts of violence. 19. Service is immediate activities and actions carried out by professionals in accordance with their respective professions in the form of counseling, therapy and advocacy for the empowerment and recovery of victims of violence.
20. Assistance is activities and actions carried out by assistants during the service process.
21. Assistant is a person or representative from an institution who has the expertise to provide assistance.
22. Institution is an agency/institution/body/within the scope of regional government and/or non-governmental organization (NGO) that provides assistance. 23. Integrated Service Center hereinafter abbreviated as PPT, is an institution providing services to victims of violence based in hospitals, managed jointly in the form of medical services (including medico-legal), psychosocial and legal services.
24. Safe House is temporary housing, provided to give protection to victims in accordance with predetermined standards.
25. Community is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and/or community organizations.

CHAPTER VII

INSTITUTIONS

Article 13

1. In the context of providing protection services to women and children from victims of violence, the Regional Government establishes P2TP2A as an integrated service center for the protection of women and children from acts of violence including victims of acts of violence.
2. P2TP2A as referred to in paragraph (1), functions as an integrated service center in providing protection to women and children from acts of violence.
3. P2TP2A as referred to in paragraph (1), above consists of the Health Office, Hospital, Police, Social Service, Manpower Office, Office of Women's Empowerment and Family Planning, Non-Governmental Organizations.
4. P2TP2A as referred to Community Organizations, Socio-Community Organizations, Universities in paragraph (3) is established by Regent's decree. (5) P2TP2A of Sorong Regency in carrying out its duties and functions may coordinate with the network of service units and competent parties in making efforts to protect women and children from acts of violence.

Article 8

1. The obligations and responsibilities of the community as referred to in Article 6 letter b, are implemented in the form of community participation. (2) The form of community participation as referred to in paragraph (1), includes: a. preventing the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children; b. providing protection to women and children from acts of violence, in the form of making rules and regulations in their respective areas starting from the Neighborhood Association level;
c. providing information and / or reporting acts of violence against women and children to law enforcement or the competent authorities; d. Participating in handling victims of acts of violence; and e. Accompanying victims to service units.
3. The form of community participation as referred to in paragraph (2), is carried out responsibly in accordance with laws and regulations.

Article 14

1. For the implementation of services for victims of trafficking in persons, the Regent of Sorong establishes a task force for the criminal act of trafficking in persons.
2. The task force for the criminal act of trafficking in persons as referred to in paragraph (1), is a coordinating institution tasked with coordinating the prevention and handling of trafficking in persons.
3. Further provisions regarding the establishment, duties, and functions of the task force for the criminal act of trafficking in persons as referred to in paragraph (1), are established by Regent's regulation.

CHAPTER V

PREVENTION OF ACTS OF VIOLENCE

Article 10

1. To prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children, the Regional Government conducts socialization, empowerment, and awareness to families, parents, and the community by providing information, guidance and / or counseling.
2. In addition to empowerment and awareness as referred to in paragraph (1), the Regional Government makes efforts as follows: a. increasing the quantity and quality of education both formal and non-formal as well as informal;
b. opening employment opportunities for women;
c. building community participation and concern for the prevention and protection of women and children from acts of violence; and d. building networks and cooperation with law enforcement apparatus, government apparatus, universities and various non-governmental organizations that work and / or care about women and children.

15. Physical violence is any act that causes pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage or fainting and or causes death.
16. Psychological violence is an act that causes fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, distrust or severe psychological suffering to a person.
17. Sexual violence is any act in the form of sexual harassment, forced sexual intercourse, whether unnatural or unwilling with another person for commercial purposes and or certain purposes.

INSTITUTIONS

Article 13

(5) P2TP2A of Sorong Regency in carrying out its duties and functions may coordinate with the network of service units and competent parties in making efforts to protect women and children from acts of violence.

INSTITUTIONS

INSTITUTIONS

INSTITUTIONS

PREVENTION OF ACTS OF VIOLENCE

18. Victim is a woman and child who experiences acts of violence. 19. Service is immediate activities and actions carried out by professionals in accordance with their respective professions in the form of counseling, therapy and advocacy for the empowerment and recovery of victims of violence.
20. Assistance is activities and actions carried out by assistants during the service process.
21. Assistant is a person or representative from an institution who has the expertise to provide assistance.
22. Institution is an agency/institution/body/within the scope of regional government and/or non-governmental organization (NGO) that provides assistance. 23. Integrated Service Center hereinafter abbreviated as PPT, is an institution providing services to victims of violence based in hospitals, managed jointly in the form of medical services (including medico-legal), psychosocial and legal services.
24. Safe House is temporary housing, provided to give protection to victims in accordance with predetermined standards.
25. Community is individuals, families, groups, social organizations and/or community organizations.

CHAPTER V

PREVENTION OF ACTS OF VIOLENCE

Article 10

1. To prevent the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children, the Regional Government conducts socialization, empowerment, and awareness to families, parents, and the community by providing information, guidance and / or counseling.
2. In addition to empowerment and awareness as referred to in paragraph (1), the Regional Government makes efforts as follows: a. increasing the quantity and quality of education both formal and non-formal as well as informal;
b. opening employment opportunities for women;
c. building community participation and concern for the prevention and protection of women and children from acts of violence; and d. building networks and cooperation with law enforcement apparatus, government apparatus, universities and various non-governmental organizations that work and / or care about women and children.

Article 8

1. The obligations and responsibilities of the community as referred to in Article 6 letter b, are implemented in the form of community participation. (2) The form of community participation as referred to in paragraph (1), includes: a. preventing the occurrence of acts of violence against women and children; b. providing protection to women and children from acts of violence, in the form of making rules and regulations in their respective areas starting from the Neighborhood Association level;
c. providing information and / or reporting acts of violence against women and children to law enforcement or the competent authorities; d. Participating in handling victims of acts of violence; and e. Accompanying victims to service units.
3. The form of community participation as referred to in paragraph (2), is carried out responsibly in accordance with laws and regulations.

CHAPTER VII

INSTITUTIONS

Article 13

1. In the context of providing protection services to women and children from victims of violence, the Regional Government establishes P2TP2A as an integrated service center for the protection of women and children from acts of violence including victims of acts of violence.

Article 9

The obligations of the family and / or parents as referred to in Article 6 letter c and letter d, who legally have full responsibility to prevent all forms of violence and protect women and children as family members.

Article 15

1. In the context of preventing acts of violence against children including the protection of children from the worst forms of child labor, a committee for the elimination of acts of violence against children will be established by Regent's decree.
2. Further provisions regarding the duties and functions of the committee for the elimination of acts of violence against children as referred to in paragraph (1), are regulated by Regent's regulation.

CHAPTER VIII

REPORTING

Article 16

1. P2TP2A of Sorong Regency is obliged to report the implementation of the prevention and protection of women and children from acts of violence to the Regent.
2. Reporting as referred to in paragraph (1) includes: a. administration;
b. finance;
c. services; and d. performance.
